sql.query:
SELECT top $rnum schedule_id, cp_code, ji_code, dcm_no, is_date, is_gb,ist_title, is_ill, obcnt, apcnt, pscnt, rccnt, iplace, jcha, remark, state, use_yn , web_yn, emtp, stime, etime, edct_expns, bank_no, bank_name, bank_ju, tel, dam_tel, srcv_date, ercv_date, brd_no,jisaname, start_yn,end_yn,ing_yn, tot_cnt FROM ( select schedule_id, a.cp_code, a.ji_code, dcm_no, convert( char(10), is_date, 23 ) is_date, is_gb,ist_title, is_ill, obcnt, apcnt, pscnt, rccnt, iplace, jcha, remark, state, a.use_yn , web_yn, emtp, convert( char(5), stime, 8 ) stime, convert( char(5), etime , 8 ) etime, edct_expns, bank_no, bank_name, bank_ju, b.tel, b.dam_tel, srcv_date, ercv_date, brd_no, replace(b.jisaname, '지회', '' ) jisaname, case when cast( srcv_date as datetime) <= getdate() +1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as start_yn, case when cast( ercv_date as datetime) < getdate() -1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as end_yn, case when cast( srcv_date as datetime) <= getdate()+1 and cast(ercv_date as datetime) >= getdate()-1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as ing_yn, ROW_NUMBER() over( order by a.is_date desc) rnum, COUNT(a.schedule_id) over() tot_cnt from TB_EDCT_SCHEDULE a, tb_apc_company_sub b where a.ji_code = b.ji_code and convert(char(4) , IS_DATE, 23) = ? and is_gb = ? $addWhere
)a where a.rnum > (?-1)*?

mapping.getProperty: schedule_id, cp_code, ji_code, dcm_no, is_date, is_gb,ist_title, is_ill, obcnt, apcnt, pscnt, rccnt, iplace, jcha, remark, state, use_yn , web_yn, emtp, stime, etime, edct_expns, bank_no, bank_name, bank_ju, tel, dam_tel, srcv_date, ercv_date, brd_no,jisaname, start_yn,end_yn,ing_yn, tot_cnt

sql.query: select schedule_id, a.cp_code, a.ji_code, dcm_no, convert( char(10), is_date, 23 ) is_date, is_gb,ist_title, is_ill, obcnt, apcnt, pscnt, rccnt, iplace, jcha, remark, state, a.use_yn , web_yn, emtp, convert( char(5), stime, 8 ) stime, convert( char(5), etime , 8 ) etime, edct_expns, bank_no, bank_name, bank_ju, srcv_date, ercv_date, brd_no, replace(b.jisaname, '지회', '' ) jisaname, b.tel jisatel, case when cast( srcv_date as datetime) <= getdate() +1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as start_yn, case when cast( ercv_date as datetime) < getdate() -1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as end_yn, case when cast( srcv_date as datetime) <= getdate()+1 and cast(ercv_date as datetime) >= getdate()-1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as ing_yn from TB_EDCT_SCHEDULE a, tb_apc_company_sub b where a.ji_code = b.ji_code and dcm_no = ?

mapping.getProperty: schedule_id, cp_code, ji_code, dcm_no, is_date, is_gb,ist_title, is_ill, obcnt, apcnt, pscnt, rccnt, iplace, jcha, remark, state, use_yn , web_yn, emtp, stime, etime, edct_expns, bank_no, bank_name, bank_ju, srcv_date, ercv_date, brd_no,jisaname,jisatel, start_yn,end_yn,ing_yn

sql.query: MERGE INTO TB_CYBER_USER_OFFLINE a USING (SELECT ? JCODE ) b ON (a.JCODE = b.JCODE ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET JDATE = getdate(), ILL_NO = ?, COMPANY = ?, MOD_YN = ?, RE_CORP_POST =?,RE_CORP_ADDR =?,RE_CORP_NM =?,RE_CORP_PRESIDENT =?,RE_CORP_REG_NO =?, BNONE_YN= ?,BNAME= ?,BDATE= ?,BAREA= ?,BADDR= ?, BJIBUN = ?,BPOST = ?,BTEL= ?, PDATE = ?,RNAME = ?,JIKWEY = ?,JM_NO = ?, TEL = ?,HP = ?,EMAIL = ?,SEX = ?, DEPOSIT_DT = ?,DEPOSIT_NM = ?, DEPOSIT_BANK = ? WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CP_CODE,JI_CODE,JCODE,JDATE,ILL_NO,COMPANY ,REQ_USER_NM,REQ_TEL_NO,MOD_YN ,RE_CORP_POST,RE_CORP_ADDR,RE_CORP_NM,RE_CORP_PRESIDENT,RE_CORP_REG_NO ,BNONE_YN,BNAME,BDATE,BAREA,BADDR ,BJIBUN,BPOST,BTEL ,PDATE,RNAME,JIKWEY,JM_NO ,TEL,HP,EMAIL,SEX ,DTL_CODE,DCM_NO,REG_DATE,STATUS ,DEPOSIT_DT,DEPOSIT_NM,DEPOSIT_BANK) VALUES (?, ?, ?, getdate(), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, getdate(), 'R', ?, ?, ?);

SELECT top $rnum user_offline_seq_no,cp_code,ji_code,jcode,convert( varchar, jdate, 23 ) jdate,ill_no,corp_nm ,req_user_nm,req_tel_no,mod_yn ,re_corp_zipcode,re_corp_addr,re_corp_nm,re_president_nm,re_corp_reg_no ,building_none,building_nm,building_start_dt,building_area,building_addr ,building_jibun,building_zipcode,building_tel_no ,chrg_ymd,user_nm,pos_nm,birth ,tel_no,phone_no,email,sex ,is_gb,dcm_no,convert( char(10), reg_date, 23 ) reg_date,jisaname,jisatel ,corp_reg_no,president_nm,corp_addr_nm,is_date ,web_yn, use_yn ,iplace,stime,etime ,start_yn,end_yn,ing_yn ,deposit_dt,deposit_nm,deposit_bank ,tot_cnt FROM ( select a.user_offline_seq_no,a.cp_code,a.ji_code,a.jcode,a.jdate,a.ill_no,a.company corp_nm ,a.req_user_nm,a.req_tel_no,a.mod_yn ,a.re_corp_post re_corp_zipcode,a.re_corp_addr,a.re_corp_nm,a.re_corp_president re_president_nm,a.re_corp_reg_no ,a.bnone_yn building_none,a.bname building_nm,a.bdate building_start_dt,a.barea building_area,a.baddr building_addr ,a.bjibun building_jibun,a.bpost building_zipcode,a.btel building_tel_no ,a.pdate chrg_ymd,a.rname user_nm,a.jikwey pos_nm,a.jm_no birth ,a.tel tel_no,a.hp phone_no,a.email,a.sex ,a.dtl_code is_gb,a.dcm_no,a.reg_date ,c.jisaname,c.tel jisatel ,d.bsns_no corp_reg_no,d.rprstt_kr president_nm ,'('+d.cpost+')'+ d.cp_addr + ' '+ d.cp_jibun as corp_addr_nm ,convert( char(10), b.is_date, 23 ) is_date
,b.web_yn, b.use_yn,b.iplace,convert(varchar, b.stime, 108) stime, convert(varchar, b.etime, 108) etime ,case when cast( b.srcv_date as datetime) <= getdate() +1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as start_yn ,case when cast( b.ercv_date as datetime) < getdate() -1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as end_yn ,case when cast( b.srcv_date as datetime) <= getdate()+1 and cast(b.ercv_date as datetime) >= getdate()-1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as ing_yn
,a.deposit_dt,a.deposit_nm,a.deposit_bank ,ROW_NUMBER() over( order by a.reg_date desc) rnum ,COUNT(a.dcm_no) over() tot_cnt from TB_CYBER_USER_OFFLINE a, TB_EDCT_SCHEDULE b, tb_apc_company_sub c, tb_mb_master d where a.dcm_no = b.dcm_no and b.cp_code = c.cp_code and b.ji_code = c.ji_code and a.ill_no = d.ill_no $addWhere and a.req_user_nm = ? and a.req_tel_no = ? and ISNULL(a.status , 'R') != 'C' ) a where a.rnum > (?-1)*?

select a.user_offline_seq_no,a.cp_code,a.ji_code,a.jcode,convert( varchar, a.jdate, 23 ) jdate,a.ill_no,a.company corp_nm ,a.req_user_nm,a.req_tel_no,a.mod_yn ,a.re_corp_post re_corp_zipcode,a.re_corp_addr,a.re_corp_nm,a.re_corp_president re_president_nm,a.re_corp_reg_no ,a.bnone_yn building_none,a.bname building_nm,a.bdate building_start_dt,a.barea building_area,a.baddr building_addr ,a.bjibun building_jibun,a.bpost building_zipcode,a.btel building_tel_no ,a.pdate chrg_ymd,a.rname user_nm,a.jikwey pos_nm,a.jm_no birth ,a.tel tel_no,a.hp phone_no,a.email,a.sex ,a.dtl_code is_gb,a.dcm_no,convert( char(10), a.reg_date, 23 ) reg_date ,c.jisaname,c.tel jisatel ,d.bsns_no corp_reg_no,d.rprstt_kr president_nm ,'('+d.cpost+')'+ d.cp_addr + ' '+ d.cp_jibun as corp_addr_nm ,convert( char(10), b.is_date, 23 ) is_date ,b.web_yn, b.use_yn,b.iplace,convert(varchar, b.stime, 108) stime, convert(varchar, b.etime, 108) etime ,case when cast( b.srcv_date as datetime) <= getdate() +1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as start_yn ,case when cast( b.ercv_date as datetime) < getdate() -1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as end_yn ,case when cast( b.srcv_date as datetime) <= getdate()+1 and cast(b.ercv_date as datetime) >= getdate()-1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as ing_yn ,a.deposit_dt,a.deposit_nm,a.deposit_bank from TB_CYBER_USER_OFFLINE a, TB_EDCT_SCHEDULE b, tb_apc_company_sub c, tb_mb_master d where a.dcm_no = b.dcm_no and b.cp_code = c.cp_code and b.ji_code = c.ji_code and a.ill_no = d.ill_no and a.user_offline_seq_no = ?
select a.user_offline_seq_no,a.cp_code,a.ji_code,a.jcode,a.req_user_nm,a.req_tel_no from TB_CYBER_USER_OFFLINE a where a.jcode = ?
UPDATE TB_CYBER_USER_OFFLINE SET STATUS = 'C' WHERE user_offline_seq_no = ? AND req_user_nm = ? AND req_tel_no = ?
UPDATE TB_CYBER_USER_OFFLINE SET ILL_NO = ?, COMPANY = ?, MOD_YN = ?, RE_CORP_POST =?,RE_CORP_ADDR =?,RE_CORP_NM =?,RE_CORP_PRESIDENT =?,RE_CORP_REG_NO =? WHERE user_offline_seq_no = ?
UPDATE TB_CYBER_USER_OFFLINE SET BNONE_YN= ?,BNAME= ?,BDATE= ?,BAREA= ?,BADDR= ?, BJIBUN = ?,BPOST = ?,BTEL= ? WHERE user_offline_seq_no = ?
UPDATE TB_CYBER_USER_OFFLINE SET PDATE = ?,RNAME = ?,JIKWEY = ?,JM_NO = ?, TEL = ?,HP = ?,EMAIL = ?,SEX = ? WHERE user_offline_seq_no = ?
UPDATE TB_CYBER_USER_OFFLINE SET DEPOSIT_DT = ?,DEPOSIT_NM = ?, DEPOSIT_BANK = ? WHERE user_offline_seq_no = ?
UPDATE TB_CYBER_USER_OFFLINE SET CP_CODE = ?,JI_CODE = ?,DCM_NO = ? WHERE user_offline_seq_no = ?
